about: A free practice chat (protocol v1.14) played on a local relay (mock chain, real NEAR AI enclave model) with relay/tools/practice-transcript.ts, the player side typed by a script. Every line is verbatim with its time in seconds from the start of the chat; the bot lines are the model output, signed in the enclave. Lines marked skip are left out of the clip; nothing is reworded or reordered. The persona is the card the game revealed after the call.
